2) Spin up GPU jobs on the 2400 H100 hrs block | | **Schedule ablation runs post‑Wednesday 11 AM lab** – cut turnaround 20% (conf 0.65) | 2nd | **Day 19** | Allocate compute window immediately after meeting | | **Allocate 200 H100 hrs for rewrite‑vs‑append split** (conf 0.65) | 3rd | **Day 19** | Reserve dedicated bandwidth in 2400‑hr quota | *All compute blocks must be slated before **Day 19** to meet ICLR revision.* # Drafted Response to Reviewer 2 > **Draft:** > Thank you for the feedback. In response to Reviewer 2’s request, we performed a controlled ablation comparing structured memory rewrite vs. naïve append. Using an external paging baseline inspired by MemGPT’s virtual context management, we show that rewrite improves F1 on needle‑survival by ~9 pts over naïve append while keeping the token budget within limits. Full results and code are attached. > We also added a periodic consolidation step before rewrite (see arXiv 0a553296) to isolate the contribution of rewrite itself, which further reduces cross‑fact interference. # Overnight Idea - **Combine periodic consolidation with structured memory rewrite** (confirmed, conf 0.78). This should magnify downstream recall beyond rewrite alone and provide a clean metric to publish in the workshop. > *Action:* Integrate consolidation step into current benchmark and measure impact before the ICLR submission rev. ---
